conditions.rightValue: ={{ (() => { const tz = 'America/Montevideo'; const now = DateTime.now().setZone(tz); const jsDow = now.toJSDate().getDay(); const lastSat = now.minus({ days: (jsDow + 1) % 7 }).startOf('day'); const jan1 = lastSat.startOf('year'); const daysToFirstSunday = (7 - jan1.weekday) % 7; const firstSunday = jan1.plus({ days: daysToFirstSunday }); if (+lastSat <= +firstSunday) return 'S1'; const firstMonday = firstSunday.plus({ days: 1 }); const diffDays = Math.floor(lastSat.diff(firstMonday, 'days').days); return 'S' + (2 + Math.floor(diffDays / 7)); })() }}
